rules.specification: Interpret plain language here as understandable word choice, following the page's elaboration. Assess sentence length, sentence simplicity and voice under their separate rules.
rules.violation_condition: Word choice is unnecessarily difficult for the intended readers to understand quickly.
when: Assess familiarity and difficulty against the intended readers.
rules.why: G-4: the instruction about understandable words elaborates the plain-language instruction rather than creating a second check.

covers.quote: Write short and simple sentences in active voice.

rules.quote: Keep sentences short to help people scan content.
rules.specification: The page supplies no word-count threshold for a short sentence. A numerical cutoff would require a separate interpretation.
rules.violation_condition: A sentence is excessively long, making the content difficult to scan.
rules.why: G-4 consolidates the repeated short-sentence instruction; the simplicity and voice requirements are distinct checks.

rules.quote: Write short and simple sentences in active voice.
rules.specification: The page does not define sentence simplicity or establish a complexity threshold.
rules.violation_condition: A sentence has unnecessarily complex structure rather than simple structure.
rules.why: The one-finding test separates structural simplicity from sentence length and grammatical voice.

rules.quote: Write short and simple sentences in active voice.
rules.violation_condition: A sentence uses passive rather than active voice.
rules.why: The one-finding test separates grammatical voice from sentence length and simplicity.

rules.quote: Clarify expressions people might be unfamiliar with.
rules.specification: Assess familiarity against the intended readers and check whether the document supplies an explanation or otherwise makes the expression's meaning clear.
rules.violation_condition: An expression likely to be unfamiliar to the intended readers is used without clarification.
when: The expression may be unfamiliar to the intended readers.
rules.why: This requires clarification of unfamiliar expressions, a distinct finding from unnecessarily difficult word choice.

rules.quote: Adjust your style to meet user needs.
rules.specification: Assessment requires information about the intended users and their needs. This page supplies no specific criteria for a suitable style.
rules.violation_condition: The writing style is unsuitable for the intended users' needs.
when: The intended users and their needs are known.
rules.why: This concerns the resulting text's suitability for users, rather than a checking or research activity under G-5.
